messages:
Maya: Heads-up: p95 for /v1/generate in prod-us-east jumped ~190ms right after we bumped routing weight toward dedicated. No infra deploy at that time. Screenshot: https://console.redwood/snap.png
Rafael: Likely a merge artifact. Endpoint-level percentiles are tdigest-merged across routes; shifting sample weights moves the aggregate p95 even if both pools are unchanged.
Sam: Oof. Our alerting is on endpoint p95 which caused a pager. We need clearer provenance or route-level defaults for SLOs.
Lisa: UX suggestion: small inline toast on endpoint pages: "Most samples: dedicated (61%)" and a one-click "show by route" toggle that flips charts to per-route p50/p95/p99. Add tooltip explaining merged-tdigest semantics.
Maya: API proposal: add query params to metrics: `merge_mode` with values `tdigest` (current), `per-route-weighted`, `per-route-max`; and `provenance=true` to return sample counts per route. Backwards compatible.
Sam: For alerting I recommend binding SLOs to route-level metrics or using `merge_mode=per-route-weighted` + min-sample guard. I'll update the runbook and add tests that simulate weight flips.
Rafael: I'll draft the API RFC and implement `provenance` payload. `per-route-max` semantics: conservative pctl = max across routes (useful for safety).
metrics-bot: metric-alert: p95 threshold exceeded for /v1/generate (prod-us-east) at 2025-03-10T15:12:08Z.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: console-canary -> 2025-03-11T02:00:00Z (will include provenance toast).
Lisa: I'll ship the UI canary tied to `provenance` when available; small copy: "Percentiles aggregated across routes. Toggle to break down by route."
Maya: Owners: Maya -> runbook + incident note, Rafael -> API RFC/impl, Sam -> alert tests, Lisa -> UI canary. If we get API + UI in the next deploy we should reduce noisy alerts during rollouts.
Rafael: Opening PR/RFC in #pr-links shortly.
